campaign.note: The full wall clock includes repeated runtime, session, CouchDB namespace and browser transport recovery. Productive authoring is reported separately.

comparisonToRun8.conclusion: The source-oriented Flow Code workflow materially reduced atomic authoring, but 24.9 active minutes remains above the 15-20 minute target.

failed: The SDK attempts services/logs.Add after offline errors despite remote logging being disabled.
Legacy img/... URLs return 404 before the configured portable image fallback renders.

toolingChanges: Persistent frontend mount actions and route state prevent catalog reset after detail navigation.
The Flow skill now documents safe source-oriented Svelte navigation.
Flow block lookup accepts documented aliases.
Named frontend source definitions round-trip correctly.
flow-app-progress no longer proposes iterator bindings inside a ForEach empty Else branch.

hardPoints.name: Diagnostic cost
hardPoints.impact: Productive flow-app-progress calls totalled 107 seconds and frontend-svelte-tree calls totalled 88 seconds; both still rebuild too much state.

hardPoints.name: Response volume
hardPoints.impact: Skill, source and picker responses remain large enough to dominate model context even after atomic mutations were removed.

hardPoints.name: Offline SDK logging
hardPoints.impact: The generated client disables remote logging, but the SDK still attempts services/logs.Add after a forced offline error.

hardPoints.name: Portable image fallback
hardPoints.impact: Fallback images render correctly, but legacy relative sources first generate noisy 404 responses.

hardPoints.name: Single Standard Edition session
hardPoints.impact: Parallel MCP clients exhausted runtime sessions; the campaign required a serialized cookie-preserving proxy.

hardPoints.name: Advertised browser origin
hardPoints.impact: openBuilt advertised port 18080 while the runtime was available on port 19080.
